assertions.name: coil: buying raises the rig's WalkSpeed

assertions.name: coil: still faster while carrying

assertions.name: drop: lands on the ground (beside ShopStand)
assertions.detail: slime bottom y=0, collidable ground y=0 (Workspace.Map.Ground), carrier root y=3

assertions.name: drop: lands on the ground (another plot's Base)
assertions.detail: slime bottom y=1, collidable ground y=1 (Workspace.Plots.Plot_2.Base), carrier root y=4

assertions.name: lockbuy: LockPrompt reads OPEN, then LOCKED after a lock
assertions.detail: "Lock base $25" / "Session Bot's base: OPEN" -> "Extend lock $25" / "Session Bot's base: LOCKED 1:00"

assertions.name: lockbuy: BuyPadPrompt buys the next pad and moves on
assertions.detail: "Buy pad $250" / "Pad 6 of 8" now on Pad_6; PadsUnlocked=5

assertions.name: claim: free plot's BuyStand has an enabled ClaimPrompt, own plot's is off
assertions.detail: Plot_2: "Claim plot" / "Free plot: everyone gets one on join"

assertions.name: claim: sends a player who has a plot home
assertions.detail: home -> Plot 1, inHomeZone=true

assertions.name: loop: tutorial walks every step
assertions.detail: Grab -> Deposit -> Lock -> BuyPad -> Merge -> Steal -> Rebirth

assertions.name: loop: skipTime pays plot income
loop: rebirth 8 with new ranks, tutorial done
assertions.detail: rebirths 8; Goo Getter > Goo Getter > Slime Wrangler > Slime Wrangler > Blob Baron > Goo Tycoon > Jelly Magnate > Ooze Overlord; failures

assertions.name: loop: upgrades bought, goals paid, 2+ slimes kept
assertions.detail: upgrades Income=8 CarrySpeed=4 OfflineCap=4 Luck=4; goal stages paid 9; slimes 3

assertions.name: ui: Slimedex panel, nav badge and plot Dex attributes agree
assertions.detail: DexCount=1/720 mask=1; "Next reward at 10: +$500 and +2% income"

assertions.name: ui: Lock / Buy-pad HUD buttons match the plot prompts
assertions.detail: "🔒 Lock $25 +60s" / "Lock base $25"; "Buy next pad 6/8 $250" / "Buy pad $250"

assertions.name: ui: PromptHide shows owner prompts only to the owner
assertions.detail: owner nil,nil,nil; other owner,owner,owner

assertions.name: ui: State.boss drives the boss banner and clears on expiry
assertions.detail: banner "👑 BOSS SLIME: Glow Epic Mueedle! Grab it at the volcano - 2:00"; after expiry active=false
